authorized_scope: Read-only source/completed-output review; write only review.md and metadata.json; no production or report generation, source edits or commit/push.

exposure.results_json_read: status fields and container structure; detailed interpretation and metrics read from completed result documentation/numerical review
exposure.large_result_review_metadata_read: selected scalar summary fields and keys; full embedded preservation payload not reviewed

receipts.shell_source_document_reads: completed; read-only cat/sed/rg plus Python3 JSON field inspection
nonmaterial_shell_errors: rg attempted nonexistent attcon/*.py path; continued with actual scripts paths
python executable unavailable; repeated read-only JSON inspection with python3

reference_provenance.current_basis: Primary-reference review supplied full source descriptions/excerpts; relevant primary papers were inspected during preceding tasks of this continuing agent. No new primary-source retrieval in this review.
reference_provenance.Ramsoy_Overgaard: author-presented typical report without participant/trial identifier; not authenticated raw transcript
reference_provenance.Lutz_S4: named participant training-report quotation; trained not spontaneous neutral reporting
reference_provenance.raw_participant_trial_gate: specific numerical psychophysical/native-task transfer only, not blanket published-semantic-structure prerequisite

retained_negative_outcomes: possible faithful technical/access-only reports cannot meet goal alone
unsupported presentation assertions fail source fidelity
future_candidate_limits: external decoder target defines objective measurement, not appearance
native raw-logit sign is stored preference, not world correctness
observed flag is sample retention, not experience presence
current/refresh are answer-correctness forecasts, not clarity
synthetic hidden/head and memory edits need explicit reachability/history limits
aggregate held-out error summaries are not individual confidence intervals
preservation: No historical failed studies, pre-output reviews, frozen protocol/source or completed diagnostic artifacts modified.
